verdict.rationale: The pack shows a few genuine spec-sheet items (ECC support, NVMe/RAID support, supported OSes) but the vast majority of AMD's own material here is marketing language (Precision Boost, EXPO, 'ultimate gaming performance', 3D V-Cache claims) rather than a full spec sheet with clocks, TDP/power, memory speed limits, or AI TOPS figures with test conditions. Independent reviews provide benchmark numbers but that is third-party testing, not the vendor's own transparent spec disclosure the story asks for. Missing for 10: published base/boost clocks, TDP/power figures, explicit memory speed/capacity limits, and any AI TOPS number with stated test conditions.
